function main() {
    $stdin = fopen('php://stdin', 'r');
    $stdout = fopen('php://stdout', 'w');

    $t = (int)fgets($stdin);
    $mod = "1000000007";

    for (; $t > 0; $t--) {
        $line = fgets($stdin);
        if ($line === false) break;
        $parts = explode(' ', trim($line));
        $n = $parts[0];
        $k = $parts[1];

        $ans = bcpowmod($n, $k, $mod);
        fwrite($stdout, $ans . "\n");
    }

    fclose($stdin);
    fclose($stdout);
}

main();

<?php

const MAX_UINT = ~0;
const MIN_UINT = 0;
const MAX_INT = MAX_UINT >> 1;
const MIN_INT = -MAX_INT - 1;

$stdin = fopen('php://stdin', 'r');
$stdout = fopen('php://stdout', 'w');

function scanf(string $format, ...$args): void
{
    global $stdin;
    $refs = [];
    foreach ($args as $key => $arg) {
        $refs[$key] = &$args[$key];
    }
    array_unshift($refs, $stdin, $format);
    $count = call_user_func_array('fscanf', $refs);
    if ($count === false) {
        throw new Exception("Scanf error");
    }
}

function reversed(string $s): string
{
    return strrev($s);
}

function divCeil(int $num, int $div): int
{
    $quot = intdiv($num, $div);
    if ($num % $div !== 0) {
        $quot++;
    }
    return $quot;
}

function min_int(int ...$nums): int
{
    return min($nums);
}

function max_int(int ...$nums): int
{
    return max($nums);
}

function abs_int(int $num): int
{
    return abs($num);
}

function isPrime(int $num): bool
{
    if ($num === 2 || $num === 3) {
        return true;
    }
    if ($num <= 1 || $num % 2 === 0 || $num % 3 === 0) {
        return false;
    }
    for ($i = 5; $i * $i <= $num; $i += 6) {
        if ($num % $i === 0 || $num % ($i + 2) === 0) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

function gcd(int $a, int $b): int
{
    while ($b !== 0) {
        [$a, $b] = [$b, $a % $b];
    }
    return $a;
}

function lcm(int $a, int $b): int
{
    return abs($a) / gcd($a, $b) * abs($b);
}

function digitAt(int $num, int $pos): int
{
    if ($num === 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    $num = abs($num);
    $lenNum = (int)log10($num) + 1;
    if ($pos < 0 || $pos >= $lenNum) {
        throw new Exception("Out of bound access for digit. Position passed $pos, number $num");
    }
    $rem = $num % (int)pow(10, $pos + 1);
    return (int)($rem / (int)pow(10, $pos));
}

source_data.prob_desc_description: Baby Badawy's first words were "AND 0 SUM BIG", so he decided to solve the following problem. Given two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$, count the number of arrays of length $$$n$$$ such that:  all its elements are integers between $$$0$$$ and $$$2^k-1$$$ (inclusive);  the bitwise AND of all its elements is $$$0$$$;  the sum of its elements is as large as possible. Since the answer can be very large, print its remainder when divided by $$$10^9+7$$$.
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: For each test case, print the number of arrays satisfying the conditions. Since the answer can be very large, print its remainder when divided by $$$10^9+7$$$.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The first line contains an integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10$$$) — the number of test cases you need to solve. Each test case consists of a line containing two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 10^{5}$$$, $$$1 \le k \le 20$$$).
